text:
anya_cs: Quick sync: Aegis Labs preflight for private/VPC cutover. Current blockers Im tracking: audit-log ingestion path, service account trust relationship, and KMS alias mapping. Can infra/security confirm status?
pete_net: audit path -> SIEM needs an authenticated forwarder. We asked Aegis to provide a long-lived forwarder token or set up an IAM role with external ID. @mike_aegis any preference?
mike_aegis: we'd rather do role-based forwarder with external ID. Security wants the external ID value before we create the cross-account role.
rosa_kms: KMS update  the customer created a key but alias points to 'aegis-key-temp'. We need alias 'redwood/aegis-runtime' mapped and a policy allowing redwood runtime role kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext.
sam_security: on the trust relationship, we must enforce least-priv and session duration <= 1h. Also logging of AssumeRole must appear in their audit stream for compliance.
anya_cs: capture actions: 1) Aegis provide external-id for SIEM forwarder role, 2) infra map kms alias and update policy, 3) security confirm AssumeRole logging is in audit pipeline. Ill mark these on the enablement runbook.
rosa_kms: policy sketch I propose:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDFW:role/redwood-runtime"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
pete_net: network snag: egress to SIEM IP range is blocked by their firewall ACLs. We gave the CIDR ranges in the onboarding doc. @mike_aegis can firewall team open outbounds to 35.198.0.0/16 and 52.0.0.0/12?
mike_aegis: putting in ticket now. ETA 6-8h for change window. If ACL change delays > 1 day, this becomes a renewal risk per Natalies threshold.
natalie_am: noted. If customer goes >7 business days with critical blockers we schedule renewal QBR prep. Logging this as conditional risk.
anya_cs: timeline note  if firewall change completes today and KMS alias switch is done, we can run a focused smoke for audit-forwarding tonight. Can deploy-bot run a targeted audit-forwarding smoke once infra signals green?
deploy-bot: scheduled targeted test job 99102. Will run when job is triggered by 'infra:green'.
rosa_kms: once alias mapped, please rotate the temp key and tag keys with 'redwood:env=priv'. Rotation window should be off-peak. Also advise customer: don't reuse the temp alias for production.
sam_security: small ask  provide an example query showing AssumeRole events in their SIEM so compliance can verify. I can share a sample if they need it.
mike_aegis: will upload external-id and cert bundle to the 'aegis/handshake' S3 path tonight. Also ok to accept the proposed KMS policy.
anya_cs: perfect. Post-checks: if job 99102 shows audit-forwarding ok and AssumeRole events present, we mark onboarding status as 'ready-for-cutover' and Ill remove the conditional renewal flag. If not, we escalate to AM for outreach. :white_check_mark:
